t: Jaipur mein property lene se pehle, Jaipur ka structure samajh lo.
Jaipur chaaron taraf se highways se ghira hai:
Delhi Road, Sikar Road,
Kalwar Road, Sirsi Road, Ajmer Road, Diggi Road, Tonk Road aur Agra Road.
Aur inko jodti hai Ring Road.
Inke beech mein hai Central Jaipur:
Pink City, C-Scheme, Civil Lines, Bani Park,
Raja Park,
Jawahar Nagar, Lal Kothi. Aur aas-paas bade residential hubs:
Vaishali Nagar, Shyam Nagar, Mansarovar, Vidhyadhar Nagar, Murlipura, Jagatpura
Lekin Central Jaipur mein zameen ab 1 se 3 lakh rupaye per gaj tak hai.
Naya middle class yahan ghar banane ka sochta bhi nahi.
Isliye log bahar shift ho rahe hain,
inhi roads ke saath-saath.
Sabse zyada growth: Ajmer Road se Tonk Road ke beech,
Diggi Road ke aas-paas.
Yahi hai Jaipur ka naya expansion zone.
Yahan nayi colonies bas rahi hain:
Bhankrota, Mahapura,
Patrakar Colony, Narayan Vihar, Muhana, Shivdaspura.
Kyun?
Kyunki yahan aa raha hai rozgaar, hospitals,
schools, colleges, connectivity, shops aur commercial.
Aur Jaipur ab sirf city tak simit nahi.
October 2025 ki JDA notification ke baad
Jaipur region lagbhag 3,000 se 7,000 sq km ho gaya hai,
aur 693 naye gaon bhi jode ja chuke hain.
Matlab growth bahar ki taraf aa rahi hai.
Aaj ka mauka Jaipur ke bahar ke ilaakon mein hai,
kyunki growth wahan pahunchegi.
Bas plot lene se pehle approval aur patta zaroor check karein.
Aapke hisaab se kaunsa road sabse tez badhega?
Comment mein likhiye,
aur Part 2 ke liye follow kijiye.
